Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

I was · you were
SubjectPast beExample
I / he / she / itwasI was at home.
you / we / theywereThey were at school.
negativewasn't / weren'tI wasn't there.
questionWas / Were …?Were you at the party?
  • Past of to be: I/he/she/it → was; you/we/they → were. I was born in 2005. They were at school.
  • Negative: was not = wasn't; were not = weren't. I wasn't at home. They weren't ready.
  • Question: Was I…? Were you…? Short: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.
  • Time words: yesterday, last night/week/year, two years ago. Where were you yesterday?

→ Past Simple verbs (I went, I played) come next.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: am/is → WAS, are → WERE. I was at home. You were at school.
  • ⚠ Я был / болдым = I WAS — the past of 'to be' is one word, no 'did' here.

Stage 5 · Listening

Listening

Listen. Then choose True or False.

You can listen again.

🔊 Where were you born? — Oxford Navigate audiolisten, then answer
1She was born in Sweden.
2She was born in 1964.
3She was born in 1980.
4She was a happy child.
5There were six children in her family.
6Her parents were rich.
7She has many brothers and sisters.
8Her father is a doctor.
9Her grandfather was a doctor.
10Her grandfather was a shop assistant.
Why these answers

She was born in Malmö, Sweden, in 1980 (not 1964). She was a happy child — there were six children. Her parents weren't rich. Her father is a doctor, but her grandfather was a shop assistant.

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two lines about the past: Yesterday I was … / Last year I was … .

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

I was born in 2000 in Almaty. In 2010 I was ten — I was at school. Last year I was in Turkey for my holiday. It was great!

Check yourself:

  • Did you use was and were?
  • Is it was (I/he/she) and were (you/we/they)?
  • Did you add a time word (yesterday, last year)?

Why

I/he/she/it → was. you/we/they → were: They WERE at school.
